dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the visible posterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity light grey to mature white baseline tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey shading localized along the lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the darker lateral shading and the central depigmented axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, sharply defined longitudinal dorsal ridge with distinct shadow-casting along the right lateral slope.
